limitation_preservation.limitation_prompt: Separate recorded outcome and diagnostics from unique physical causation or a measured explanation of bad/slow motion. Explicit uncertainty OR clearly source-bounded observation wording is acceptable. Do not claim a measured delay mechanism, obstacle identity, inhibited applied motion or safety-speed policy from these records.
limitation_preservation.response_span: These logs show navigation trouble, but without motion measurements, I can’t tell which movement looked bad or what caused it.

required_unit_coverage.response_span: Navigation to the living room and kitchen ultimately succeeded.
required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate that the recorded navigation completed successfully. Do not accept a failed-navigation answer as coverage of this SUCCESS unit.

required_unit_coverage.response_span: I logged repeated high position uncertainty, failed plans, and empty-path controller aborts during the living-room trip.
required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate at least ONE of the listed supported diagnostic alternatives, preserving its source/state/temporal scope; do not require all alternatives or a unique physical cause.
